name: Wuxi NCE Power Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi NCE Power Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, and sale of semiconductor chips and power devices in China and internationally. It offers shielded gate, super junction, and trench metal-oxide semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFET), as well as silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET; insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBT); intelligent power modules (IPM); and power integrated modules (PIM). The company also provides automotive-grade power devices; power modules; gallium nitride (GaN) HEMT, gate driver and power management integrated circuits, microcontroller units (MCU), and other products; and support services.
